cases.rationale: The foreground has an actual skateboard deck and orange wheel, and passenger cars are identifiable along the street ahead. Tiny upright forms on the distant left sidewalk are insufficiently detailed to decide person (0). The large silver vehicle cropped at the upper right could have a truck body, but the saved fragment does not resolve that identity, so truck (7) is unclear. The board is not a snowboard or surfboard; the urban poles are not identifiable traffic signals. After considering every frozen definition, no other category has visible supporting evidence.

The plate contains bread triangles with visible filling, banana rounds, pale red-skinned apple pieces, orange sections and strawberries. Open bowls containing white food at the upper left and salad at the upper right have identifiable rims and bodies. The main black serving plate is not itself counted as a bowl. A shiny spoon-like utensil is partly cut off along the right edge; its bowl and handle are not sufficiently resolved for spoon (44), which remains unclear. No clear fork tines or knife blade are visible. Strawberries and other food do not establish any additional defined fruit or vegetable category. Every definition was considered; there is no other unresolved category ambiguity.

The intersection contains actual passenger cars, including the yellow taxi and white car, and clearly identifiable suspended and roadside traffic signal heads. Small human pedestrians are visible at sidewalk level by the buildings. The taxi is a passenger vehicle, not evidence for a bus or truck; overhead trolley wires alone do not establish a train. Building windows, signs and poles do not establish screens, clocks, stop signs or parking meters. I considered all 75 definitions across the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual long-haired dog is airborne over grass beside a white flying disc at its mouth. The disc shape and catching context identify a frisbee, not a plate or other round vessel. The fur pattern does not indicate a cat, bear or stuffed toy. The distant red boundary flags are not kites or stop signs. Explicit consideration of all 75 definitions found no additional category evidence and no unresolved category ambiguity.

The central shirtless human and partial humans at both sides are actual people using skateboards; decks and wheels are visible, including the board under the central rider. The concrete skatepark ledges and metal rails do not identify benches, dining tables or chairs. Trees and grass have no pot context. After explicit consideration of every frozen definition, no additional category is supported and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A small actual passenger car is visible across the road, and a long public bench with seat, back and supporting legs appears on the promenade at the lower right. The prominent prohibitory signs contain skateboard/dog pictograms; these depictions are excluded, and no actual skateboard or dog is present. Neither sign is a stop sign. The ornamental street lamps are not traffic lights, and the palms are unpotted trees. Every frozen definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Breakfast plates and several open food bowls sit on an actual dining table surrounded by individual metal chairs. A green drinking bottle has its bottle body and capped neck visible; the purple beverage carton is not counted as a bottle. A fork with tined head and handle lies diagonally to the right of the near plate. A tiny pale vessel-like object behind the chairs at the upper right could be a cup, but the occlusion and detail do not resolve its identity, so cup (41) is unclear. Toast, eggs and potatoes do not identify sandwiches, bananas, cake or other defined foods. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; no other unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two beds with mattresses and bedding occupy the right side. At the left is the narrow side of a standalone television with its base on a chest of drawers, and a partial single-person chair with upholstered seat/back and wooden arm is visible below. The round foreground surface has no dining/eating context and is not counted as a dining table. The white drawers are furniture, not refrigerator or oven evidence; the lamp is not a vase. Considering all 75 definitions produced no additional positive or uncertain category, and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual human hands are next to a layered frosted cake with one slice removed. Many glass bottles with narrow necks and several disposable cups sit on the dining table. A cake-cutting knife is visible near the lower-right hand, and wooden chairs are identifiable in the background. The flat serving and eating plates do not establish bowls; the cake-top illustration is excluded as an actual animal. Every definition was considered across the full crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A full-size bus body with its characteristic continuous passenger windows and wheels is mounted above an actual painted boat hull; identifiable reused bus and boat bodies meet the part-based definitions. The life ring is not a donut or frisbee. A narrow white vehicle fragment at the far left may be part of a passenger car but is too cropped to establish car (2), so that remains unclear. Painted decoration does not establish actual depicted objects. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions; no other category ambiguity remains.

Several actual people fill the crop. The man on the right wears an identifiable blue necktie and holds a clear straight-sided drinking tumbler, which counts as a cup. The woman in the center and the partially visible woman at the left hold stemmed wine-glass forms with bowls and stems. The man's shirt graphics and the floral clothing do not establish additional actual objects, and no bag is identifiable. After considering every frozen definition, no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual child is shown playing baseball, wearing a large tan fielding mitt with visible pocket, webbing and lacing. This is an actual baseball glove rather than a batting or ordinary hand glove. The airborne baseball is not a frisbee, and the printed shirt emblem does not establish any actual category object. The rest of the saved crop is grass and dirt. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
